# Legacy numerical handovers

These bytes came from `numerical_uv_join OUT valid` at 9825273d1a44d176b06c9bf3a8d9c03a9f9c9884, before the numerical record layout tags.
They retain a valid 3 mm cube with two native UV bindings and one previous checked state.
Current readers must refuse both positional payloads with `handover.version-mismatch`.
Keep these historical fixtures when the current encoder changes.
